title: Timescape observational tests

baseline.label: Timescape two-region averaged geometry with wall observers
baseline.scope: Retain source timescape averaging, spatially flat walls, negatively curved voids and lapse/dressed-observer prescription. Flat ΛCDM is a comparison cosmology, not retained timescape dark energy or geometry. This is an observational-test prospect for the same mechanism, not a new combined cosmology.
baseline.parameters_reason: No accepted timescape parameter set or source-to-catalogue mapping is registered; historical fits and proxy settings are not adopted.

cosmology.gravity: Phenomenological two-region Buchert averaging of Einstein equations with an additional uniform-quasilocal-expansion observer prescription; effective averaged metrics are not claimed exact Einstein solutions.
cosmology.geometry: Flat wall regions and negatively curved voids with evolving volume fractions; volume-average time t differs from wall proper time tau; dressed radial effective metric is not global constant-curvature FLRW.
components: Coarse-grained matter, bare curvature and kinematic backreaction in the retained timescape branch.
No homogeneousLambda in the timescape explanation; the reply lists radiation in averaged closure but this prospect supplies no validated early-universe/perturbation implementation.
modifications: Averages and lapse distinguish bare from wall-observer dressed expansion and distances.
The two new methodological ideas constrain likelihood conditioning and proxy fidelity; they do not add new physical fields.
cosmology.background: Source volume-average relations plus wall-observer lapse identity are reviewed here. The source papers do not supply a complete unique inhomogeneous spacetime or object-level catalogue map.
cosmology.perturbations: No closed structure/peculiar-motion/light-cone system is accepted. No CMB/growth/BAO perturbation qualification follows from these supernova and proxy papers.
observables: Conditioned paired Pantheon+ evidence and selection sensitivity under source dressed distances.
Joint relative-Hubble/finite-infinity-sightline statistic after observer-consistent mapping is derived.

scope: A separate observational-test prospect for two complementary contracts; no multiplication of evidence or assumed cross-observable independence.
The existing timescape-tracker-distance-lineage prospect remains the background implementation/old-reduction route; this prospect does not clear its blockers.
unknowns: Exact published SN run/data/covariance/conditioning and proper priors.
Observer-consistent local catalogue prediction and full uncertainty/selection/mock-dependence contract.
Full perturbation, early-universe and modern observational viability remain unassessed.

combination_compatibility.basis: Both tests retain the source timescape model. Methodological constraints are not combined physical sectors; no joint likelihood or independent observational confirmation is accepted.
